title: Microsoft Dataverse: run prompt columns on existing records in bulk (backfill)
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft supports the backfill controls, their defaults, credit consumption and documented job limits. The admin paths and AI prompts API are valid; the job-management instructions should include selecting a job and opening its Actions menu.

claims.claim: Dataverse prompt columns can generate values for existing records in bulk.
claims.quote: Prompt columns can now generate AI values for records that already exist in your table, not just new or updated ones.

claims.claim: Makers choose whether to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk.
claims.quote: Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk

claims.claim: Makers can filter bulk processing to the rows they need.
claims.quote: optionally filtered to just the rows they need
